user_story: As a user, I want the system to reject a new password shorter than 8 characters during reset so that security standards are maintained.

positive.title: Password reset with a valid password length
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Enter a new password that is exactly 8 characters long.
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the new password and confirms a successful reset.

negative.title: Password reset with an invalid password length
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Enter a new password that is shorter than 8 characters.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the new password and displays an error message indicating that the password is too short.

edge.title: Password reset with no password entered
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Leave the new password field blank.
edge.expected_result: The system rejects the password reset attempt and displays an error message indicating that the password field cannot be empty.
